blocks.text: Match preview: Western Australia face Queensland in 3rd Match (TEST) on Thu, 8 Oct, 2026, 8:00 am at W.A.C.A. Ground Perth. Full pitch report, weather forecast, and squad details below.
Pace and bounce typical of Australian wickets; good carry for fast bowlers.
Variable conditions · High 17°C / Low 13°C · Rain: 13.6 mm · Wind: up to 23 km/h. Rain likely — DLS may apply; favour bowlers who hit the deck and teams with depth.
International playing XI is announced at the toss. Check back on match day for confirmed line-ups.
